population: 10594 existing development participants, dev0/1/2. Baseline-source July 14 fields with its zero imputation and prefix mask, separate smoking. No protected assessment.
selection: Strictly greatest calibration AP; earliest tie. Calibration max F1, largest threshold on ties. No evaluation target selects a model. For A/B/C the identical outcome-free pretraining is freshly fitted once for each fold/seed then branched; D starts at its matched random initialization. Same fine-tuning sampling and risk dropout. Fixed epoch secondary comparison at epoch 10.
supervision: Growth-marked maximum is the maximum diameter among recorded growing nodules, zero if no such entry in an otherwise eligible measured report. Only CT with dated valid read, adjacent eligible same-patient landmark, before known diagnosis day, no incomplete long measurement or conflicting change-form nodule code. A verified eligible CT with no recorded nodule contributes the no-measurement category. Unknown CT is masked. Primary task includes all eligible landmarks.
aux: Same 7-class dominant/absent label and log1p millimetre values for B/C/D. Common LayerNorm->64 GELU->15 head. Cross-entropy plus mean smooth L1 on eight decoded sizes among reports with positive long measurement. Fixed first maximizer in ties. C/D use class-conditioned decoding; B independent nonnegative regression. Identical true-class teaching during training, hard predicted class during evaluation. Report gradient accumulated on same pooled representation. Natural eligible CT prevalence monitored on held patients.
baselines: Nine historical algorithm families refitted to exactly the same 14 values, prefix availability and smoking. No missingness indicators absent from A. Two tabular views using only these fields; historical family grid. Five archived neural adapters, 45 epochs and 8 calibration candidates, 7:1 controls. CPU only.
analysis: AP averaged equally over three folds and three seeds. Foldwise F1/MCC after calibration, top fractions with ties; positive coverage and enrichment. 2000 stratified whole-patient paired bootstrap draws, seed 20261122; shared weights across methods/seeds. Pointwise percentile interval and simultaneous one-sided studentized max deviation for B-A, C-A/B/D, and C vs all nine. Baseline goal C minus strongest >=0.003 and simultaneous lower bound >0 vs every baseline. Internal development inference conditional on fitted models. No change or selection with evaluation results.
